# Business Impact

- **Increased Pipeline Visibility and Granularity:** By implementing enhanced Lead-to-AUM and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting, PURE Financial Advisors LLC will obtain granular, actionable insights into pipeline performance, allowing leadership to pinpoint trends and bottlenecks at every stage of the client journey [Client Questionnaire].

- **Optimized Marketing ROI:** Automated tracking of CAC enables PURE to evaluate return on marketing spend at a more granular level, facilitating data-driven decisions that can improve marketing efficiency and potentially reduce acquisition costs by up to 20% through targeted investments [Client Questionnaire].

- **Operational Efficiencies via Automation:** The proposed solution will automate data ingestion, transformation, and reporting refresh processes—replacing manual tasks with batch pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. This shift is expected to reduce manual effort and reporting cycle times, freeing up resources for high-value activities [Client Questionnaire].

- **Integrated Data Ecosystem:** Seamless integration with Salesforce, QuickBooks, Tamarac, and Azure platforms enables PURE to consolidate critical business metrics in Power BI, eliminating data silos and improving data quality for reporting and analytics [Client Questionnaire].

- **Strategic Value Creation and Scalability:** The robust, scalable data model and reporting suite will support PURE’s data maturity goals, setting a foundation for future growth and advanced analytics as new data sources and business needs emerge [Client Questionnaire].

- **Competitive Advantage Through Data-Driven Leadership:** Enhanced Power BI dashboards with well-defined KPIs will empower senior leadership and marketing teams to proactively adjust strategy based on real-time insights, giving PURE a distinct edge in the financial advisory market [Client Questionnaire].

The overall value of this engagement will be demonstrated through improved reporting accuracy, operational efficiency, and strategic clarity. By enabling PURE Financial Advisors to make better informed decisions, this solution positions the company for sustained growth, superior client engagement, and greater competitive differentiation in the U.S. financial advisory industry.
